text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Rain again.
Guess I can't run today either, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Doing only indoor training
is gonna make me go soft~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Tsuru-chan~.
There is no need to worry, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, it's time for
'laid-back strength training'~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What is that?!
What kind of workout is that?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Let's give it a try~.
First, please do a regular squat as you normally would~."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah...! My legs are starting to shake!!
I can't take any more of this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first clear day in a while. When I headed out to the track with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
How's that~!
Check out this super, razor-sharp running~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like she was speaking unusually slowly for some reason, but...
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's running only became more polished after that!
